zh.title: LATAM巴西航空A320客機於巴西降落時偏離跑道 151人平安疏散
zh.summary: LATAM巴西航空A320降落巴西偏離跑道；機上151人平安疏散無人受傷
body: LATAM巴西航空一架載有151人的空中巴士A320客機（ICAO機型代碼A320），於2026年8月31日在強降雨中降落巴西卡斯卡韋爾機場（CAC）時偏離跑道。該班機為從聖保羅/瓜魯柳斯國際機場（GRU）飛往卡斯卡韋爾的LA3858航班，於當地時間約09時45分在15號跑道進行迴轉操作時離開鋪設地面並停於泥濘中。
LATAM表示機上145名乘客與6名機組人員均安全疏散，未收到任何受傷報告。事故發生時機場受雷雨影響，能見度降至2英里以下。事故發生後卡斯卡韋爾機場關閉，LATAM已取消返航之LA3859航班，並正配合相關調查單位進行後續處理。

en.title: LATAM Airbus A320 Runs Off Runway in Heavy Rain in Brazil, All 151 Passengers and Crew Safe
en.summary: A LATAM Airbus A320 ran off the runway at Cascavel; all 151 passengers and crew evacuated safely.
body: A LATAM Airlines Brasil Airbus A320 (ICAO type code A320) carrying 151 people ran off the runway while landing in heavy rain at Cascavel Airport (CAC) in southern Brazil on August 31, 2026. The aircraft was operating Flight LA3858 from São Paulo/Guarulhos International Airport (GRU) to Cascavel when it left the paved runway at approximately 09:45 local time during a backtrack maneuver on Runway 15.

LATAM confirmed that 145 passengers and six crew members evacuated the aircraft safely with no reported injuries. Severe weather with thunderstorms had reduced airport visibility to under two miles. Following the incident, Cascavel Airport was closed, and LATAM canceled return flight LA3859 while cooperating with authorities investigating the runway excursion.
